tokens.name: ebony
tokens.usage: Text, headings, dark surfaces and focus outlines.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Button fills, accents, progress and active-tab underline. Never text on light surfaces.

tokens.name: ochre
tokens.usage: Secondary markers and avatar fills. Never text.

tokens.name: taupe
tokens.usage: Quiet decorative lines and upcoming states. Never text.

tokens.name: secondary-text
tokens.usage: Secondary text on white or stone.

tokens.name: primary-tint
tokens.usage: Light tint behind ebony text for hovers and badges.

groups.name: Rethink Sans
groups.note: All functional UI text, names, section headings, labels and numbers. Figures always lining.

styles.name: person-name
styles.usage: Candidate and placement names. Wraps to two lines; never truncates.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: We keep in touch through the first three months.
styles.usage: Running text, 65 characters a line at most.

groups.name: Newsreader
groups.note: Regular non-italic for page-level h1 headings; italic 400 for a trainer's own words, always attributed.

styles.name: attestation
styles.sample: Arrives early, sets up without being asked, and stays calm when the queue is out the door.
styles.usage: Trainer's own words. Never headings or decoration.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside a component: icon to label, between early seam stitches.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between related items; card padding on phones.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gaps between cards.
